en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural landscape with a narrow wooden footbridge crossing a small river or stream in the foreground. The bridge leads across open fields toward a low hill topped with trees and a white church with a tall, pointed steeple on the left side of the image. The sky is partly cloudy. Printed text in a cursive style appears at the bottom of the postcard.
